title: His warmth reached me
heading: His warmth
reached me.
paragraphs:
One bed.
One Noodles.
No Purugly.
alt: Noodles warms the edge of Shelby’s soft blanket while Sparkles and Syrup sleep beside her.

title: Room for Shelby
heading: Room for
Shelby.
paragraphs: The bed failed to acquire an edge.

One body needed room.
Everybody made it.
alt: Shelby rests on the hospital bed with her family gathered close around her.

title: Back to the meadow
heading: Back to
the meadow.
paragraphs: On the day I could travel again, you lifted me into your arms.

The road turned toward Floaroma.
Then toward the Windworks.
alt: Shelby is carried out in her blanket, with Noodles, Sparkles and Syrup close beside her.

title: I waited
heading: I waited.
paragraphs: So this was the part where Shelby stayed and everybody else went.
I waited for your footsteps to return to the road.
alt: Shelby lies alone among white and yellow flowers, looking toward the path.

title: Instead—FWUMP
heading: Instead—
FWUMP.
paragraphs: The picnic blanket opened beside me.
alt: The red picnic blanket opens beside a surprised Shelby as her family gathers around her.

title: Everybody here
heading: Everybody
here.
paragraphs: My squiggles loosened beneath your hand.
No part of Shelby had to move.
alt: Shelby rests beneath a caring hand beside her family on a picnic blanket, with flowers and the Windworks beyond.
